shape.layouts: array|absent - verbatim SlideForge layouts (LayoutEntry[]: index, name, placeholders...)
shape.workzone: {left,top,width,height}|absent - normalizeWorkzoneBounds: accepts width/height or right/bottom; requires finite left/top and width>0,height>0 (workzone.ts:80-93)
shape.logoKey: 'brand/<ownerId>/<brandId>/logo.png' only when brandId given AND masterImages has role 'logo' or 'logo_mark' AND the write succeeded (brand-pptx-background.ts:218-241)
shape.furnitureKey: 'brand/<ownerId>/<brandId>/furniture.json' only when brandId given and capturedFurniture.layouts has >=1 of cover/divider/content (brand-pptx-background.ts:246-268)
shape.furnitureArchetypes: present iff furnitureKey; order = Object.keys(capturedFurniture.layouts) filtered
shape.headingPlaceholders: {cover?,divider?,content?: {left,top,width,height,font?,color?,sizePt?}} only for furniture archetypes whose heading normalizes (brand-pptx-background.ts:275-286; brandKit.ts:160-175)
shape.layoutPreviews: [{index, name}] sorted by index, only when brandId given and >=1 layout rendered; index re-keyed to brand-extract's layout index by slug when every rendered layout matches, else renderer order; name = extracted layout name, else slug title-cased, else 'Layout <index+1>' (brand-pptx-background.ts:135-155,290-295; layoutPreviews.ts:29-46)
shape.masterKey: NEVER produced (declared in BrandPptxFields blobs.ts:229 and src/types.ts:158 but not written)

externalCalls: Netlify Blobs read; no paid APIs
quirks: Unknown jobId -> 200 {status:'pending'} forever (no 404); a client must time out on its own (frontend 90x2s, Connector 150s).
Extraction failures are 200 with status 'error' + error text, never an HTTP error.

fields passes through SlideForge data unvalidated (layouts, typographyScale, masterDecorations, logoShapes, allColors). Some fields (layoutPreviews) are NOT accepted by PATCH /api/brands ('Unknown kit field: layoutPreviews'), so callers must filter before PATCH.
Job records are never deleted (no TTL in code).
beforeAnyState: Job not yet written / never existed -> 200 {"status":"pending"}.

tests.asserts: Producer of `fields`: furniture blob stored at brand/u1/b-1/furniture.json and fields carry furnitureKey + furnitureArchetypes; no furniture ref when capturedFurniture null or no brandId; unrecognized archetype keys ignored. STATUS 2026-10-08: 3 of 4 tests FAIL (timeout 5s) - STALE TEST, not a handler bug. The fetch stub (mockExtract, test lines 29-31) returns the same JSON for every fetch, so the render-layouts call (added after the test was written; brandId is set) gets non-ZIP bytes, JSZip throws, renderLayouts sleeps 5_000ms before its retry (brand-pptx-background.ts:78-81), exceeding vitest's 5s default timeout. Only the no-brandId test (which skips rendering) passes. Fix would be a fetch stub that routes /render-layouts, or fake timers. Handler code is the oracle.
